about: [O1b] The swim (brief §2, O1 Left 6): on foot off Pier 7's open end by W - into the water, the eye at the water (the swim mode), no fade, no fail - then W to the foot of the pier's steps (their globe lamp at the landing): up them and on the pier, on his feet; then through a quay steps' landing into the water and out up a slipway's ramp. node tools/play.mjs tools/plays/o1b_swim.json

steps.eval: (G.save.flags.taught = { city_in: true, city_drive: true, city_map: true }, G.stage.part('stream').warmAround(95, 530), N.controller.setPose(95, 530, Math.PI, 0), window.__sw = { fails: 0 }, G.on('city:ashore', (e) => { window.__sw.out = e.how; window.__sw.outT = performance.now(); }), 1)

steps.label: in the water: swimming, the eye at the water, no fade

steps.walk: (() => { const s = G.stage.part('city').C.steps.find((q) => q.pier === 'PIER 7'); return [[s.foot[0] + 1.5, s.foot[1] + 4], [s.foot[0], s.foot[1]]]; })()

steps.eval: ({ out: window.__sw.out, secs: +((window.__sw.outT - window.__sw.inT) / 1000).toFixed(1), at: [+N.controller.pos.x.toFixed(1), +N.controller.pos.z.toFixed(1)], ground: +N.controller.groundY.toFixed(2) })

steps.label: up the steps onto the pier, on his feet, in under 30 s

steps.eval: (() => { const s = G.stage.part('city').C.steps.find((q) => q.kind === 'quay' && q.x > -60 && q.x < 10 && q.nz > 0.9); window.__q = s; G.stage.part('stream').warmAround(s.top[0], s.top[1]); N.controller.setPose(s.top[0], s.top[1] - 2.5, Math.PI, 0); window.__sw.out = null; return [s.x, s.z]; })()

steps.label: through the landing's gap and in: swimming
out up the slipway's ramp, wading
